name: flickdirect-connect
description: Free movie MCP server: facts, news, reviews, trivia, quote discovery, soundtrack links, podcasts and shops.

interface.longDescription:
Explore movies and television with FlickDirect Connect, FlickDirect's free, read-only movie MCP server.

Find published movie facts, cast, trivia and quote discovery, brief exact excerpts when supplied, and canonical source links. Discover production trivia across titles without guessing a movie, with optional topic, title, year and media filters. Read country-specific release dates and ratings for the United States, United Kingdom, Canada and Germany when stored. Missing values stay omitted.

Search site-wide news and reviews, including industry stories without a movie association and CinemaCon reporting. Find relevant bounded passages in articles, written reviews and eligible stored interview, video-review and movie-news show transcripts, podcast shows and recent episodes with Apple Podcasts links, FlickDirect apps and public company information, daily release anniversaries, streaming and soundtrack links, and daily movie deals when available.

Receive brief source previews and direct links to full FlickDirect coverage. Connect does not supply full articles, reviews, transcripts or photographs. Published YouTube watch links and embedded players are supported.

No FlickDirect account, key or subscription is required. Availability and tool refresh controls depend on your AI app. Compatibility does not imply an official partnership or endorsement.

Version 1.4 adds source-confirmed spelling corrections and ambiguity signals. Clarify similarly named works and preserve country labels, published dates and source links.

Version 1.4.1 validates published entity/source-kind evidence and performs bounded recovery for restrictive editorial searches. It preserves original source and YouTube links. Matching diagnostics do not establish answer accuracy.

Version 1.4.2 adds the current FlickDirect shop collection, conservative retailer name-variant matching and optional fresh retrieval. Curated shop inclusion, explicit recommendation text and published commercial disclosures remain distinct. Fresh fetch time does not prove upstream content is current. Existing tool names and inputs remain compatible.

Version 1.4.3 adds per-request service-version attribution to the private seven-day usage report. Existing connections, public tool names and supported inputs remain compatible. It does not change model weights.

Version 1.5 adds quote discovery summaries and source links, without original dialogue, and soundtrack/player plus Additional Songs links with published affiliate parameters. These are availability summaries, not invented dialogue paraphrases; music links do not establish track lists or scene placement. Bounded scheduling and finite caching preserve the existing two read-only tools and legacy inputs. Optional fresh retrieval also works for movie details. No paid model calls or model training.

Version 1.5.1 adds canonical citation bundles for ordinary questions, title/year normalization, and reviewed T2 and X2/X-Men 2 defaults verified against returned movie identities. Explicit full-title/year context overrides defaults. Optional brief exact quote excerpts use complete sentences with an ellipsis for omitted following dialogue; otherwise use a natural source-page description and link. Existing tools, inputs, affiliate links, privacy and seven-day retention remain compatible. Host applications control tool selection and final answers; no model training or automatic deployment.
capabilities: Read cast, trivia and published movie facts

Search published news and review previews

Find Terminator 2 and show the UK and Canadian dates and ratings FlickDirect has available.
Find FlickDirect articles about Samsung Onyx cinema technology.
